preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 2 * 10**5 for n in ns)
preconditions.description: Number of vertices in each test case is between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(len(a) == n for a, n in zip(as_, ns))
preconditions.description: Length of the visiting order matches the number of vertices.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= n for a, n in zip(as_, ns) for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex in the visiting order is between 1 and n.
The first vertex in the visiting order is always 1 (the root).

preconditions.expression: all(len(set(a)) == len(a) for a in as_)
preconditions.description: All vertices in the visiting order are unique.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines matches the number of test cases.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(height, int) and height >= 0 for height in output)
postconditions.description: Each output height is a non-negative integer.
